platform: Windows 11 native, Python 3.11/3.14, no WSL, no new dependencies

task1_constructor_compatibility.allows: AutoEvolution(None, data_dir) for configure(), status(), queue_goal(), cancel_goal() and emergency_stop()
task1_constructor_compatibility.blocks: run_once() and start_scheduler() raise AutoEvolutionError without an attached engine; upgrades additionally fail closed unless a functioning Git Safety Gate inspects the work tree

task2_isolated_upgrading.minimal_copy_set: target backend file + transitive backend/tests import closure (cap 40 files, 256 KiB each) + matching focused test files; whole-repository duplication avoided
task2_isolated_upgrading.cycle: build -> analyze (mock/offline inference) -> staged candidate -> isolated apply -> syntax + secret scan + focused unittest subprocess -> tested/rejected
promotion_gates: Git Safety Gate must prove a clean live work tree (dirty = candidate held in isolation)
original sha256 comparison against live files (concurrent owner edits detected, candidate marked stale)
live regression gate (test_repair_candidate) and clean-tree recheck immediately before activation
post-activation health detect with rollback_repair + emergency stop on failure
never_done: no automatic promotion into a dirty live repository
no automatic commits of owner files
task2_isolated_upgrading.same_day_sequence: multiple sequential isolated upgrades per day supported (quota checked only at live promotion; FIFO promotion order by candidate age)
task2_isolated_upgrading.retained: emergency stop, rollback_repair, per-workspace candidate records, shared audit.jsonl history, restart-safe on-disk reconstruction

scenarios: successful upgrade + promotion with every unrelated live byte proven unchanged
failed isolated tests -> rejected candidate, live untouched
rollback on failed post-activation health check -> emergency stop
concurrent owner modification -> stale candidate, owner edit preserved
dirty live tree -> isolated_staged hold, later promotion after gate recovery
restart reconstruction over persisted D: state
minimal workspace proof (30 noise backend files not copied)
end-to-end D: default smoke with mock inference
